section.title: Normalizing symbol tokens
section.para: SymbolJoinerCharSequenceNormalizer maps a supported symbol only when it is the complete input. A phrase such as Dungeons & Dragons, an embedded symbol such as R&D, padded input such as " & ", and ASCII forms such as (TM) are unchanged. The fixed English replacements are matching conventions, not rules for reading symbols in context. Currency symbols and symbols followed by variation selectors are unchanged.
For per-token matching, use tokens that retain the symbols. The following example uses whitespace boundaries and stores normalized forms with the original spans:

WordTokenizer, used by default in TermAnalyzer, omits the ampersand; applying a normalizer afterward cannot recover it. Choose a tokenizer that retains the symbols needed for matching, or supply pretokenized input. There is no built-in symbol-expansion term dimension; normalize token forms explicitly as above. This normalizer does not implement OffsetAwareNormalizer and cannot be included in buildAligned(). In the example, the spans refer to the original tokens, not character positions within the expanded words.
